style: Palette of deep indigo night, violet haze and rose-magenta light, with pale teal highlights.

images.name: hero
images.prompt: Ultra-wide establishing view from deep space of a fully developed star system at peace. In the far background a bright white-gold star partly wrapped in a delicate glittering lattice of thousands of solar collector panels. In the foreground the curve of an Earth-like planet with blue oceans and city lights on its night side, encircled by two luminous orbital rings joined to the surface by thin space elevator threads. Ring-shaped colony stations and long cylinder habitats float between the worlds, and orderly streams of tiny ship lights flow along gentle curved lanes between them. Calm, prosperous, monumental. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.

images.name: eradication-wars
images.prompt: Wide battlefield view on a burning colony world under a red sky: towering humanoid war mechs striding through ruined prefab city blocks, enormous warships trading beams of light in low orbit overhead, a cracked energy shield dome flickering above the city, columns of smoke and distant explosions, tiny infantry silhouettes for scale, desperate apocalyptic total war with nobody holding back

images.name: milky-way-war
images.prompt: Vast space battle at the edge of a glowing nebula: a disciplined fleet of sleek white and silver warships in formation firing streams of light into an enormous swarm of organic space monsters, writhing hive creatures with chitin plates, glowing maws and long tendrils, some as large as moons, reaching toward a colonized planet with city lights behind the fleet, epic scale

images.name: expedition
images.prompt: A lone small dark stealth starship drifting through the black emptiness between galaxies, approaching a colossal ruined alien megastructure, broken rings and spires the size of continents with faintly glowing geometric seams, debris floating around it, distant spiral galaxies hanging in the void, a sense of discovery, loneliness and danger

images.name: wilderness
images.prompt: The edge of the universe seen from inside: a gigantic curved wall of swirling cosmic storms rising like the inner slope of an enormous bowl, galaxies, stars and debris being swept up the curve and tumbling back down, veins of lightning-like energy across the storm wall, a tiny research starship in the foreground observing it, awe-inspiring and strange

images.name: civilization
images.prompt: Street-level wide view of a sunny walkable city plaza of the far future. Clean modular buildings with bold colour-coded stripes of sky blue, white, gold and green; a sleek tram on ground rails; a green park with trees at one side. The plaza is full of a joyful crowd of beautiful bioengineered people who have clearly redesigned their own bodies: a woman with lavender skin and glowing teal hair, a man with large white feathered wings, a person with fox ears and a long fluffy tail riding a bicycle, someone with iridescent scales, a tall person with ram horns. Among them walk slender graceful humanoid robots with smooth white shells, and friendly aliens in sleek transparent-helmet environment suits. People skateboard, ride scooters, chat and laugh. Warm optimistic daylight. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.

images.name: chaos-rift
images.prompt: A colossal wound torn in space engulfing two star systems: a jagged spreading tear of violent violet and crimson energy erupting from a shattered planet, a gigantic broken satellite cannon drifting in the foreground, storms of glowing cosmic mist swallowing space stations and moons, streams of evacuation ships fleeing as points of light, eerie and catastrophic

images.name: monsters
images.prompt: Seen from a distance in the empty black void between galaxies, with no ground and no planet surface anywhere, an endless roaming horde of monsters drifts through space toward a distant glowing spiral galaxy. The horde mixes many kinds: colossal biomechanical leviathans of bone and metal, swarms of spiky self-replicating war machines, a grey cloud of glittering metallic particles, and enormous asteroids overgrown with pulsing red flesh and hive openings. The horde stretches to the horizon in overwhelming numbers, lit by a sickly glow. Dread and scale. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.

images.name: ftl-launch
images.prompt: In deep space at the dark outer edge of a star system, the home star only a small bright point far behind. A colossal ring-shaped launch gate floats in empty space, built from segmented metal and lit with guiding lights. Beside it rises a giant floating coil tower like a tesla coil, which shoots a bright plasma tether beam that latches onto a sleek white starship passing through the ring. The starship is accelerating into faster-than-light flight: its frontal shield has flared into a brilliant pointed cone of plasma ahead of its nose, a shimmering rainbow-coloured energy field wraps its hull, and its engines leave a blazing circular wake. No ground, no planets nearby, no people. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.

images.name: planetship
images.prompt: Wide side view of a whole Earth-like planet being towed through deep space, travelling from left to right. The planet is on the left, wrapped in a thin translucent geodesic climate shell that glows softly from inside, held by a wide orbital ring lined with dark radiator fins. On the right, ahead of the planet and separated from it by a wide gap of empty space, floats a massive ring-shaped tug structure. Hundreds of engines around the tug's rim fire long blue-white plumes backward toward the left, but every plume is angled sharply outward so they fan wide around the planet and never touch it, like a giant open umbrella of light sweeping past it on all sides. Tiny escort ships with trailing lights; stars and a faint nebula behind. Immense scale, careful engineering. No people. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.
